risks.risk: True brand/model identity mismatch could indicate wrong item, mislabeled relisting, or intentional misrepresentation
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo or video of the nameplate/rating label and any model/serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/unverified brand, worst case treated as generic unbranded unit

risks.risk: Working condition unknown (motor, spin cycle, drum integrity)
risks.proof: Video of unit powered on, filling, agitating, spinning and draining

risks.risk: Missing accessories (inlet/outlet hoses, lid, control knobs)
risks.proof: Photos of all sides including back (hose ports) and top control panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing standard accessories

risks.risk: Hidden damage, rust, or leaks not visible from the single front angle
risks.proof: Photos of rear, underside, and interior drum
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, worst case cosmetic/structural issue

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history, affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date sticker or purchase receipt

risks.risk: Capacity and model number unknown, affecting value tier
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common capacity tier for the claimed brand category

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the nameplate/rating label showing true brand, model, and capacity
Video of the machine powered on and running a full cycle (fill, wash, spin, drain)
Photos of the back of the unit showing hose connections and condition
Photo of the top panel with lid open showing drum interior
Any receipt, warranty card, or manufacture date sticker
response.reason: The seller's claimed brand (Midea) directly contradicts the visible 'NEXUS' label in the photo, a classic sign of a mismatched or bait-and-switch listing that must be resolved before any price can be trusted.
